contract: Each item uses schema/item.schema.json; source field paths are retained for audit while the canonical item groups them by scenario, environment, observations, candidates, decision, attempts, verification, feedback, observability, annotations and quality.

requiredness.required: Every final dataset item should carry the field.
requiredness.recommended: Collect whenever the relevant channel is observable; absence must be explicit.
requiredness.conditional: Collect only when that method channel/stage is present.
requiredness.optional: Analysis, training, weak-proxy, or ground-truth-only feature.

literature_contract.paper_ids_rule: Each field separates strict core experimental seeds from schema/method references.

literature_fields.notes: 来源包括 Accept/Reject/Settings、Close/Cancel 等；语义词表和协议动作需保留来源，不可合成无出处标签。

our_method_requiredness_legend.required: Every episode record must carry the field.
our_method_requiredness_legend.required_if: Required when the condition written after the colon is true.
our_method_requiredness_legend.required_if_observable: Required only after the target-device capability probe establishes observability.
our_method_requiredness_legend.recommended: Not needed to parse the record, but needed for the planned analysis or reproducibility.

our_method_missing_value_policy.rule: Never use an unqualified null or empty string.
our_method_missing_value_policy.ios_boundary: iOS/XCUI and VoiceOver capabilities are candidates until verified on the target device and OS. XCTest/Appium page-source visibility must not be treated as VoiceOver focus, utterance, or deployable accessibility visibility.
